topic: Assess our security posture and identify priority remediations.
description: Evaluate security controls, identify gaps, and prioritize remediation actions.
investigationInstructions: Inventory current security controls (auth, authorization, encryption, network).
Review OWASP Top 10 coverage for the application stack.
Assess secrets management and key rotation practices.
Evaluate dependency vulnerabilities and outdated packages.
Check access controls and least-privilege enforcement.
Review logging, monitoring, and incident detection capabilities.
Identify compliance gaps (SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA if applicable).
Prioritize remediations by risk and effort.
evidenceRequirements: Current architecture diagram and technology stack
List of dependencies and their versions
Access control policies and role definitions
Incident history and log retention settings
expectedOutputStructure: Executive summary with overall security rating
